title: IND vs SL: The ninety minutes! Moving day comes early in gloomy Galle
content: A rain-hit Day 2 in Galle turned into a frantic 90 minutes as Sri Lanka's bowlers struck in quick succession, dismissing India's overnight batters and bringing the hosts back into the contest. Devdutt Padikkal's 167 and a crucial lower-order stand kept India in control, but the pitch is beginning to offer the turn and bounce expected in Galle.

title: US immigration authority: These forms will be rejected from September 15
content: USCIS will introduce new editions of immigration forms I-539 and I-765. These revised forms will be effective starting September 15, 2026. Applications submitted using older forms after this date will be rejected. This change aligns with a recently published immigration rule. USCIS emphasizes there will be no grace period for this form update.

title: From burnt cash to possibly first impeachment: Justice Varma saga explained
content: Justice Yashwant Varma's residence was engulfed in flames, leading to the shocking discovery of burnt currency notes. A subsequent parliamentary inquiry confirmed serious charges against him, prompting his resignation. The Centre's pursuit of impeachment aims to set a strong precedential framework for judicial accountability. This case also poses critical questions about the interplay between a judge's resignation and ongoing disciplinary proceedings, potentially impacting future cases of judicial misconduct.

title: Hockey World Cup: India hold Olympic silver medallists China to 2-2 draw
content: India kicked off their Hockey World Cup journey with a challenging 2-2 draw against China. Navneet Kaur opened the scoring, putting India ahead early on. However, Zhang Ying equalised with a penalty stroke. Deepika regained the lead for India with a penalty corner in the second quarter, only for Ma Ning to score in the third and equalise again.

title: MacKenzie Scott helped abolish $40B in medical debt; how mechanics work
content: MacKenzie Scott's donations have enabled medical debt abolition across America. Her model allows acquiring debt at low costs and then forgiving it. This approach has inspired other billionaires to contribute millions to similar causes. While philanthropic efforts are scaling, policy reforms for medical debt remain stalled. Scott's work highlights immediate relief possibilities and the need for systemic change.

title: Padikkal falls for 167, joins Dravid and Pujara in Sri Lanka record list
content: Devdutt Padikkal's remarkable 150-run milestone during a rain-interrupted Test match highlights his growing prowess as a cricketer. He joins the elite ranks of Rahul Dravid and Cheteshwar Pujara with this achievement from the number three position. The match faced multiple delays due to weather, and despite losing Rishabh Pant and KL Rahul after resumption, Padikkal's performance stands out as a defining moment in his career.

title: Actor Ananya Raj dies: Family says she died peacefully in sleep; fans mourn her work
content: Actor Ananya Raj, known for '7 Hours to Go', 'The Final Exit' and 'Ghost', passed away at 27 on July 15 after battling physical and mental health issues for over a year. Her family shared the news on Instagram, calling her a "strong spirited girl." She also worked in regional films like 'Thaggede Le'.

title: Elon Musk makes a promise to employees at townhall
content: SpaceX aims to enhance its AI model Grok by integrating insights from its workforce. Elon Musk envisions this initiative as a means to embed human values deeply into the AI's framework. Employees are not only invited to enhance the internal AI systems but are also inspired to share their expertise.

title: 'Girls laugh, cry, then go numb': 608 flee Maha school amid 'mass hysteria'
content: Students fled a school in Melghat fearing spirits after experiencing laughing fits. Officials diagnosed the unusual behavior as mass psychogenic illness, a collective stress reaction. The incident highlighted existing management issues at the Doma village ashram school. Overcrowding and poor sanitation contributed to the students' anxiety and fear. Authorities plan awareness drives to combat superstition in the region.

title: AI Express flyer's pistol 'accidentally' goes off at Varanasi airport; 2 injured
content: Two security screeners were injured at Varanasi airport on Sunday morning. A passenger's licensed pistol accidentally discharged during a routine weapons check. The incident occurred while the passenger was preparing to board a flight to Mumbai. Both injured personnel received immediate medical treatment for their wounds. Local police are currently investigating the exact circumstances of the accidental discharge.

title: 'Human cost of relentless political hostility': Mamata on TMC leader's suicide
content: The former West Bengal CM Mamata Banerjee claimed that Asish Banerjee was "repeatedly maligned, falsely accused and subjected to relentless pressure". She said: The harassment and mental pressure he faced, despite his long record of public service, should make all of us pause and reflect on the human cost of relentless political hostility". Meanwhile, West Begal chief minister Suvendu Adhikari said he would ensure probe into suicide.

title: UP officers invoke Bhagat Singh, Buddha to explain duty, justice and use of force
content: During the Independence Day celebrations in Uttar Pradesh, two officers reflected on public service and the importance of accountability. One officer referenced Bhagat Singh to address the frustrations surrounding the justice system's inefficiencies. The other drew from a Gautama Buddha story to discuss the responsible use of police authority, emphasizing that with greater power comes a duty to prioritize service over personal interests and mere salary considerations.

title: PV Sindhu turns to sports science, S&C in bid for record sixth Worlds medal
content: PV Sindhu won her biggest title since 2019 at the Japan Open earlier this year. There has been a gradual improvement in results and as she goes for a record sixth BWF World Championships medal, the focus is not just on what's happening on the court. The 31-year-old has turned to sports science and a strength & conditionining team to iron out the chinks in her armour.

title: Where are gold and silver prices headed next week? Fed minutes, Middle East in focus
content: Gold and silver prices may continue their upward trend next week. Geopolitical and economic cues will significantly influence this momentum. Analysts expect bullion to retain its positive bias amid global data. Investors will monitor US housing, trade, and inflation figures closely. Federal Reserve meeting minutes will also provide monetary policy outlook signals.

title: TMC leader's suicide: CM Suvendu vows probe into possible 'threat' angle
content: Asish Banerjee Banerjee was found dead on Sunday morning at a Trinamool Congress office in Rampurhat, Birbhum district. Police said his body was found hanging and was sent for post-mortem examination. The exact circumstances surrounding his death remain unclear. A teacher by profession, Banerjee had represented the Rampurhat Assembly constituency five times. TMC legislator Kunal Ghosh called for an impartial probe.

title: For 12 remote villages near China border, power is finally in sight
content: Remote villages in Uttarakhand's Johar Valley will soon receive grid electricity for the first time. This significant development will benefit approximately 180 seasonal residents and ITBP personnel stationed there. The electrification project, costing Rs 21 crore, spans sixty-one kilometers and includes twelve villages. Power lines have been laid up to Rasgadi, with Bugdiyar also slated for electrification shortly.

title: Market recap: Top 5 firms lose Rs 1 lakh cr in value; TCS, Reliance suffer biggest hit
content: Last week witnessed a downturn in Indian stock markets, with five out of the top ten firms experiencing notable decreases in market capitalization. TCS and Reliance Industries led the decline in valuations. In contrast, LIC and Bharti Airtel reported impressive gains. Despite these fluctuations, Reliance Industries held its position as the leading firm in terms of market value.

title: How members of England’s 1939 Chess Olympiad team became wartime codebreakers
content: As World War II erupted in 1939, England’s chess team withdrew from the Buenos Aires Olympiad. In Grandmaster Aarav Dengla’s fourth column for TOI, he explores how three players, Hugh Alexander, Stuart Milner-Barry, and Harry Golombek, returned home to join Bletchley Park. Harnessing chessboard skills like pattern recognition and strategic elimination, they played pivotal roles in cracking Germany’s Enigma code, helping secure Allied victory while keeping their wartime contributions secret for decades.

title: 'Awarapan 2' box office day 3: Movie set to cross Rs 70 crore on Sunday

On its third day, it grossed four point seven one crore rupees, bringing its overall net collection to over sixty crore rupees. It maintains a commanding lead against rival films in cinemas. Read on to know more in detail.

title: Cauvery water row: SC to hear Tamil Nadu plea against Karnataka on August 17

The state government has alleged that both the quantity recommended for release by the Cauvery Water Regulation Committee and the actual water supplied by Karnataka were far below its requirement.

title: ‘Very embarrassing’: Ponting tears apart Australia after Bangladesh shock

With the selectors facing mounting pressure to rejuvenate the faltering Australian side, Hayden proposed adding Sam Konstas and Matt Renshaw to strengthen the lineup. This match is notable as it marks Australia's first Test loss to Bangladesh on their own soil.

title: India cooks up LPG safety net: Govt fixes refinery-wise output targets

Reliance Industries leads with the highest targets assigned to its refinery. It is imperative that companies ensure sufficient infrastructure for LPG storage and transportation. These production benchmarks will undergo reviews and updates biannually.

title: 'Makes my blood boil': CJP seeks arrest of Bengal student's father's killers

title: Bizman climbs car bonnet to stop girlfriend leaving with friend, falls to death

He sustained severe head injuries and was pronounced dead at the hospital.  Police are investigating the unnatural death and examining CCTV footage.  Further legal action will be taken based on collected evidence and reports.

title: 'Team didn’t have confidence in me': Jadeja’s candid revelation that left him 'disturbed'

He acknowledged that batting lower in the order deeply impacted his confidence and self-belief. Jadeja noted that the team's lack of trust in his batting capabilities contributed to his struggles. His reflections came on the heels of India’s impressive Day 1, highlighted by Devdutt Padikkal achieving his first Test century against Sri Lanka.

title: Raja Sen dies at 70: Three-time National Award-winning filmmaker passes away
content: Legendary Bengali filmmaker Raja Sen departed this world on Sunday at the age of seventy. Renowned for his exceptional contributions to cinema, he was a proud recipient of three National Film Awards. Sen was receiving treatment for health issues at Kolkata's SSKM Hospital. His journey in the industry began in television before making a significant impact in feature films. He leaves behind his beloved wife and two daughters.

title: Navy sailor, wife and 2 children found dead at Mumbai home
content: A sailor and his two young children were discovered deceased at their Mumbai residence. Preliminary findings suggest the sailor died by suicide, while the children may have been poisoned. Police have initiated a thorough investigation into the tragic incident. Post-mortem and forensic reports are awaited for confirmation of causes. Investigators are gathering statements from witnesses to establish the sequence of events.

title: 'Entering politics was mistake': Mamata aide Asish Banerjee's suicide note surfaces

Banerjee had served as a five-time MLA and held ministerial portfolios. He stepped down from a party committee after losing his seat. His body was taken for a post-mortem examination.

All patients are reported to be in stable condition at the hospital.

title: Over 100 arrested in Morocco over fresh Ceuta migrant crossing attempt
content: around 111 people arrested in ceuta for attempting another border crossing . the arrests came about two weeks after a large influx of migrants reached Ceutan . 109 of those arrested were from sub-Saharan Africa and two were Moroccan nationals .

title: Nasa’s Moon base: Too early to tell where India fits in
content: the agency’s new Moon Base programme envisages a sustained human presence near the lunar South Pole . it is built gradually through robotic missions, crewed landings, commercial landers, rovers, power systems and, eventually, habitats .
